name: Spresiano (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and black, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Spresiano (the name SPERCIGLANVS on red above a hill on blue) within branches.
history: The flag was granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 30 January 2025.

features.role: Spresiano arms — name SPERCIGLANVS on red above a hill on blue, crowned, within branches
